title: Prepositions of time: at, on, in
en:
at + clock time and some expressions: at 9 o'clock, at lunchtime, at night, at the weekend, at the moment.

on + days and dates: on Monday, on 5 May, on my birthday, on Friday morning.

in + months, years, seasons, parts of the day, periods: in March, in 2026, in winter, in the morning, in two weeks (= after two weeks).

No preposition with this, next, last, every, tomorrow, yesterday: I'll see you next Monday.
ru: at — время на часах, at night, at the weekend. on — дни и даты (on Monday, on 5 May). in — месяцы, годы, сезоны, части дня (in the morning), in two weeks = через две недели. Без предлога: next, last, this, every, tomorrow.

boss.situation: Describe your working week and next month's plans: use at, on and in at least twice each, and one sentence with next or every.
samples: I start work at eight o'clock.
On Mondays we have a team meeting.
In the afternoon I usually test controls.
In December we prepare the annual report, and next month I'm going on a training course.

qs.exp: in + period = after that time from now.
qs.ru: Через два дня — in two days.

qs.q: “See you on next week” is correct.
qs.exp: No preposition with next: See you next week.

qs.q: “I don't work at the weekend” is correct British English.

qs.exp: Part of the day → in the evening (but at night).

qs.q: Our busiest month is December. Everyone works hard ___ winter.
Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: the audit starts on monday morning
qs.exp: Day + part of the day → on Monday morning.

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: i check my emails at nine every day
qs.exp: at + clock time; every — no preposition.

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
Correct the mistake: “I'll call you in Friday.”
a: I will call you on Friday.

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “He works in night.”
Correct the mistake: “We met at last year.”

a: The meeting is on Monday at 9 a.m.
The meeting is on Monday at nine.
The meeting is at 9 a.m. on Monday.
The meeting is on Monday at 9am.
The meeting is at nine on Monday.
I will finish in a week.
I'll finish it in a week.
I will finish it in a week.
